defects.description: Incorrect translation of the term "disk quota"; should use the required equivalent "дисковая квота" (or correct plural form).
Term "disk quota" rendered as "квоты дисков", which does not match the required equivalent.
Heading uses non‑standard phrase "квот дискового пространства" instead of the required term for "disk quota".
Phrase "включите квоты дисков" does not use the required glossary term for "disk quota".
Phrase "включить квоты дискового пространства" incorrectly translates the term "disk quota".
